title: Job's Thankful Morning Prayer
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Long, long ago a man named Job
loved God with all his heart;
He was so kind to all he met,
right from the very start.

[Chorus]
I'll love Heavenly Father, too,
and thank Him night and day;
Not only when the sun is out,
but all along the way.

[Verse 2]
He had a happy family,
and animals to keep;
Each morning Job would pray for them,
his love for God ran deep.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
So close your eyes, my little one,
and whisper thank-you too;
For all your blessings, big and small,
God's near, and He loves you.

[Chorus]
mood: Thankful music. A soft, even rocking moves under the voice, like a morning prayer said the same way every day, calm and full of thanks. The first two verses keep that warm, unhurried sway as Job counts his blessings. By the last verse it slows and sinks lower, the thank-yous turning into a whisper as the child drifts off.
